top_signal.title: Struggling in a family run business
top_signal.summary: Just found this subreddit today and figured I'd try and ask for some advice.   I'm 19 years old, my dad had bought a shop in a neighbouring town to which myself, my brothers and him have been working at for the past 6 or so months. (We do get paid, my dad insisted).   It's a mechanical shop, to which my dad and brothers repair all sorts of things (Cars, machinery, farm equipment etc), as well as wielding and metal work.   I have no qualifications myself, and isn't really something I'm inclined to enter an apprenticeship for.   For my jobs, I manage the front. We sell a huge variety of things, a lot of stuff I'm still finding new and didn't even know we have. (Honestly, the customers know mostly what we sell anyways lol). When we bought the business we got all the stock that was in the shop. The previous owner has been helping me with figuring out the layout and how their system worked, but obviously I can't rely on them forever, and whilst they are around sometimes and I occasionally ask questions, I've figured a lot out on my own.   What I'm struggling with is the huge amount of responsibilities and tasks. On paper, it doesn't sound like much, but when you have like 50+ Supplies with items spread out across each one, managing product and ordering is stressing. I have a spreadsheet with all the items listed with their suppliers, but if I have to keep searching each product up then it gets time consuming.
